name: SMPSSB
description:
SUPPORT ONLY BEDROCK FOR CHILL CHIL Last version.

Online 24/7, disable ping/online player.

Please join and enjoy

Are you looking for a relaxing place to build, explore, and unwind? Welcome to the ultimate chill Minecraft experience! Our server is exclusively designed to support only Minecraft Bedrock Edition, ensuring a seamless, optimized gameplay environment for our entire community. We are currently running the absolute latest version of the game, so you can enjoy all the newest blocks, mobs, and features without missing a single beat.

Whether you are a late-night builder or an early-bird explorer, our world is hosted on dedicated hardware and remains fully online 24/7. Your next great adventure is always ready and waiting for you, whenever inspiration strikes you. To maintain our truly laid-back and highly immersive atmosphere, we have intentionally disabled the server ping and the online player list visibility.

This means absolutely no pressure, no tracking, and zero distractions. It is just you, the tranquil environment, and the pure joy of uninterrupted survival gameplay. Leave all of your daily stress behind, gather your favorite tools, and start building your ultimate dream base today. We would absolutely love to have you join our growing family. Please join the server right now, make yourself completely at home, and most importantly, just chill and enjoy yourself!
